original_bug_mechanism: Clearing or compacting storage leaves an old saved-frame iterator active.
synthetic_bug_mechanism: Compaction moves data and pointers but fails to return reclaimed bytes to the writable-capacity counter.
distinctness: The original upstream fix is retained. Compaction moves data and pointers but fails to return reclaimed bytes to the writable-capacity counter.
oracle: After dropping saved frames, CanWrite must include the reclaimed space and writes into it must succeed without altering the pending payload.
realism: A storage-compaction change can update pointers while overlooking cached capacity; iterator invalidation remains correct.
test_changes: Minimal additions to the existing regression suite; original tests and assertions preserved.
